name: Zhu Xian Ji Ning Shi Shen Yuan Zhe
source:
Li Haonan is a 30-year-old office worker living in Taipei. Struggling with the pressures of work and modern relationships, he joins a matchmaking agency in the hope of finding a partner.

There, he meets a woman named Ruyan, and what begins as a promising romance gradually draws him into a web of secrets, manipulation, and betrayal.

Set in contemporary Taiwan, The Witch Trials EP1: The Abyss Gazer is a dark, linear visual novel exploring love, obsession, revenge, and the price of happiness.
